text:
olivia: Quick heads up — want to unhide a beta UI flag next week for the advanced query panel (flag: `ui_advanced_queries`). Need to align on canary scope + guardrails. Planning window: Tue 04/05-04/09.

raj: +1. Proposed canary: 3% of orgs, prefer accounts created >90 days to avoid churn. region split: NA + EU only for first week.

maria: Telemetry question — what events do we need to track? I want to ensure we have explicit metrics for usage and regressions.

olivia: Good call. Telemetry we want: `ui.adv_query.open`, `ui.adv_query.run`, `ui.adv_query.error`. Also capture token counts and response latency. Alert if error_rate > 1% or median latency increases by 30% vs baseline.

sam: For console controls, what's the toggle key? Is it behind `featuregate.adv_query` or `ui_advanced_queries`? Need the exact key for SDK and docs.

june: We agreed on `featuregate.ui_advanced_queries` last sprint; docs and SDK expect that. I'll add a small note in devex. Also recommend an explicit org opt-out CLI: `redwood feature off --org <id> ui_advanced_queries`.

raj: Canary audience selection approach: sample orgs by hash(account_id) % 100 < 3 AND account_age_days > 90 AND NOT in partner_tier. That avoids sending to our largest customers.

maria: Can we add a server-side kill switch and auto-disable if downstream LLM error spikes? Suggest: if `llm_5xx_rate > 0.5%` for 5m, flip flag off for all canary.

olivia: Agreed. Guardrails: server kill, per-org quota cap (max 20 calls/day during canary), and soft-rate-limit in UI with prompt hint "Beta feature — limited usage".

sam: Code review / PRs ready? Ping me the PRs and I'll prioritize. Also need a small UI tooltip copy from content/team.

june: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4286 (featuregate + backend) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/189 (docs). @sam can you review the console PR? It's small.

sam: On it, will review within today. Please add test that ensures flag state is respected in server-side rendering path.

launchbot: rollout-scheduler: Rollout job queued for 2026-04-06T15:00:00Z. Canary: 3%; Regions: NA, EU. Auto-rollback: enabled (thresholds applied). :rocket:

maria: Quick ask on dashboards — can someone provision a canary dashboard with these panels: canary usage count, error_rate, median latency, avg tokens per run, and a list of orgs in cohort.

raj: I'll create the Grafana board and share link by EOD. Will include org-level rows to eyeball any noisy customers.

olivia: Communications: Product will send a short note to beta users in the console "You're in the advanced queries beta — feedback welcome". Marketing will avoid wide email; keep it in-product only.

june: Also adding a small help doc under Settings > Beta features with how to opt out and link to feedback form.

sam: Any special QA? I can run a smoke that toggles flag, hits SSR, and exercises client-side render/hydration.

olivia: Perfect. Post-rollout checks: 1h, 6h, 24h. If stable after 24h, increase to 10% and expand regions. If anything bad, rollback immediately and open an incident channel.

maria: I'll set alerts for the thresholds and add an extra watch on `ui.adv_query.error` to fire a PagerDuty if >1% for 10m.

raj: FYI — avoid exposing the underlying model selector in the beta. Keep it fixed to `gptx-8k-quant` until we finish perf tuning.

olivia: Noted. Anything else? If not, I'll draft the rollout checklist and share here.

sam: Small nit — update the feature flag naming in the SDK changelog.

june: Draft checklist would be great. Also include rollback playbook and contact list.

olivia: Checklist shared: https://drive.redwood/rollouts/ui-adv-query-checklist (DM if no access). I'll follow up with the PR links once CI passes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

launchbot: deploy-bot: scheduled job running preflight checks now. CI gated: all tests passing required for rollout to proceed.

maria: Looks good. Thanks — I'll monitor the dashboards during rollout windows. :eyes:

raj: Approved from infra side. :+1:

sam: Reviewing PR now. Expect comments in the morning.

olivia: Great. Closing the coordination loop — we'll reconvene async if anything pops up.
